svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The walk, and what it writes down
svg.desc: Eight steps in two groups. Read (worksheet Part A): list the layers and their lead times in the slow case; find each layer's need date and commit point; read the stage and the range still open at each commit point, and whether the driving attribute is known. Decide (worksheet Part B and footer): choose how far up the range to cover; net against what you have; split each layer into firm, flexible and named; agree change bands per stage; write it down and get supply's answer. The steps flow into four artifacts: the declaration register entry with its bands (mechanism 12), a commit-point map line per layer (13), the supply request and supply's answer (11), and the fulfillment ledger line (5), whose net and committed columns come from steps 5 and 6. A decision note is added where a commit point fell before the event that resolves it. Method steps are numbered pills, unlike the funnel's numbered squares.
svg.text: Read
worksheet Part A
List the layers and their lead times, using the slow case
every layer it touches: a usual and a cautious lead time
Find each layer's need date and commit point
commit point = need date (next layer's start) − cautious lead time
Read the stage at each commit point, and the range still open
is the driving attribute known by then? If not, choose and write it down
Decide
worksheet Part B, and its footer (step 7)
Choose how far up the range to cover
by the layer's shortage-to-idle ratio, in the layer's own units
Net against what you already have
target − on hand − on order − due back + retiring; each dated, owned
Split each layer into firm, flexible and named
firm to the base; flexible to the step 4 target; named above it
Agree change bands per stage
how far size and date may move before a priced event; supply signs
Write it down, and get supply's answer
four artifacts; supply answers with a dated commit or a named gap
Writes into
mechanism no., owner
Commit-point map line, per layer
supply chain, with planning

text.tspan: Decision note, where a commit point fell
before the event that resolves it

svg.text: declaring team; planning keeps it
Supply request and supply's answer
planning carries the gap
